title: So why haven't social apps offered interpretation until now?
Social conversation is demanding, and older AI couldn't keep up
text:
Problem
Continuous translation
Pressing buttons keeps breaking the flow
Live translation
Batch processing only
Voice interpretation
Text output only
Speech recognition
Misses even basic sentences
Multilingual
No Korean, among others
Language switching
You keep switching languages by hand
Utterance split
Doesn't break speech into sentences
Speaker split
Can't tell several speakers apart
Cost
About $2 per hour

title: AI progress now makes every one of these solvable
text:

Multilingual

Utterance split
